memories.content: Lucia Ferreyra is the director of a nonprofit organization. She has prepared a concept note for the Alder Foundation and intends to submit it. She hopes for a substantive response within a month.

The Alder Foundation accepts unsolicited concept notes via email. The foundation's current funding priorities are publicly known. Lucia Ferreyra can send her concept note to the foundation's general submissions email or to a specific program officer if known.
